summary: Phase-1 MVP launch-readiness pass for v0.9.74-dev. Release proof gates all green: 654 cargo tests pass, clippy -D warnings clean, focusa preflight ok, Spec104 static audit (new_globals=0 missing_routes=0 missing_cmds=0), Guardian docs scan clean, daemon health ok on 0.9.74-dev. Version normalized across README, menubar (package.json + Cargo.toml + tauri.conf.json + Settings.svelte), action.rs, and runtime docs. Audit CLI bug fixed: /v1/events/recent no longer trips API_TIMEOUT on unrecognized event_type (LIKE scan now bounded by 50k recent rows + input validated). official_release_bundle is license-gated; this artifact is the open-source equivalent.
why: Operator reported an extensive e2e CLI sweep needed before MVP launch and pointed to a real bug in focusa audit (API_TIMEOUT on bad event_type). Agent feedback scored Phase 1 readiness at 72% (Operator Preview) and called out version drift, Spec104 missing-routes/missing-cmds, and stale release-proof as blockers. This pass addresses each.
next_action: Activate a Focusa Operator or Commercial license to run `focusa release prove --tag v0.9.74-dev` and produce the official_release_bundle proof; without a license, `focusa preflight` (status=ok) is the open-source equivalent. Then ship v0.9.74-dev tag.
